The compositions of two typical synthesis gels to obtain ITQ-37 are as follows: 0.5 SiO2:0.5 GeO2:0.25 SDA2(OH)2:0.50 NH4F:3 H2O, without aluminium, and 0.5 SiO2:0.5 GeO2:0.01 Al2O3:0.25 SDA2(OH)2:0.50 NH4F:3 H2O, with aluminium. Crystallization was carried out at 175 °C over 24 h under static conditions.

SDA2 is a bulky diquaternary ammonium molecule with formula C22N2H40. The chemical formula of ITQ-37 is |(C22N2H40)10.5(H2O)x|[Ge80Si112O400H32F20].

NH4F is the source of fluoride ions.
